subject: Life Sciences
topic: The brain, eye defects, the ear and disorders
topicAf: Die brein, oogdefekte, die oor en afwykings

items.q: Which part of the brain controls balance and muscle coordination?
items.qAf: Watter deel van die brein beheer ewewig en spierkoördinasie?
items.explain: The cerebellum coordinates movement and balance.
items.explainAf: Die serebellum koördineer beweging en ewewig.

items.explain: The medulla controls involuntary actions such as heartbeat and breathing.
items.explainAf: Die medulla beheer onwillekeurige aksies soos hartklop en asemhaling.

items.q: During a fright, the sympathetic nervous system causes:
items.qAf: Tydens ’n skrik veroorsaak die simpatiese senuweestelsel:
options: a faster heart rate and dilated pupils
items.explain: The sympathetic system prepares the body for fight or flight.
items.explainAf: Die simpatiese stelsel berei die liggaam voor vir veg of vlug.

items.explain: In myopia light focuses in front of the retina; a diverging (concave) lens corrects it.
items.explainAf: By miopie fokus lig voor die retina; ’n divergerende (konkawe) lens stel dit reg.

items.q: When a bright light shines into the eye:
items.qAf: Wanneer ’n helder lig in die oog skyn:
options: the radial muscles contract and the pupil widens
the circular muscles of the iris contract and the pupil gets smaller
optionsAf: trek die radiale spiere saam en die pupil word wyer
trek die sirkulêre spiere van die iris saam en die pupil word kleiner
items.explain: The pupil reflex protects the retina from too much light.
items.explainAf: Die pupilrefleks beskerm die retina teen te veel lig.

items.explain: A clouded lens blurs vision; it can be replaced surgically.
items.explainAf: ’n Troebel lens maak sig vaag; dit kan chirurgies vervang word.
